# Latetwenties

> Latetwenties is a small Auckland marketing agency. We help local service
> businesses across New Zealand and Australia get found online and chosen by
> local customers. We treat the website, the Google Business Profile, the
> listings and the review systems as one connected thing, and we treat the
> business owner like a person, not a dashboard.

Founder: Brendan MacDonald
Based: Auckland, New Zealand
Working: New Zealand and Australia
Email: team@latetwenties.agency
Phone: +64-9-884-4418
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm NZT
Website: https://latetwenties.agency

## What we do

Two products, plainly priced. No long lock-ins.

- **Foundations**: a one-time build covering the website, Google Business
  Profile, listings, SEO and AI-search foundations, and review systems.
  From $2,500 NZD. Two to four weeks, end to end. Yours to keep when it's
  done.
- **Presence Care**: ongoing care that keeps your signals strong. Posts,
  reviews, listings, iterative SEO, and a regular update on what's working.
  $1,200 NZD a month. Three-month minimum, then month-to-month.

## Who we work with

Local service businesses, owner-led, close to the work. Builders,
electricians, plumbers, landscapers, mobile mechanics, physios, dentists,
allied health practitioners, accountants, lawyers in their own practice,
cleaners, tutors, family businesses. Anyone whose customers search "near me"
or their suburb name.

The market we serve sits between "established" and "can't yet afford one of
the big agencies."

## Recent work

**Boaz Developments** (builder, Mangawhai, Northland NZ)
From not appearing on the Google map pack (average rank 10.1) to #2 across
the neighbouring towns, in under two months. Engagement: Foundations and
Presence Care. ChatGPT now recommends Boaz at position #1 when asked for a
builder in the Mangawhai or Langs Beach area.

## Frequently asked

**How long does Foundations take?** Two to four weeks, end to end. The first
week is research; weeks two and three are the build; week four is launch and
handover.

**What's the minimum on Presence Care?** Three months, then month-to-month.
Long enough for the work to land in search results and for review velocity
to lift.

**Do you work outside Auckland?** Yes. Across New Zealand and Australia.
Most of what we do is remote.

**What if I already have a website?** We'll take a look before recommending
anything. Sometimes it's a rebuild, sometimes it's leave-it-and-focus-on-
Presence-Care.

**Do I own everything?** Yes. Website, domain, Google Business Profile,
every account we set up, all in your name.

**Why not hourly rates?** Hourly rewards slow work. Fixed pricing rewards
getting the work done properly.

## How we work

Manaakitanga is the operating value. A Māori value about how people care for
each other. Mana (a person's standing, dignity, spirit) joined with aki (to
uplift or support). It's about the owner across the table, not the business
in front of them. We listen properly. We carry your reputation with the same
care you would. The work follows from that.

## Voice

Plain-spoken, NZ-grounded. No hype, no jargon, no marketing fluff. We treat
your business with the same seriousness you treat it yourself. Honest about
what's working and what isn't. Wins celebrated. Bits that aren't landing
said out loud, not hidden under a softer chart.

## What we don't do

- Lock-in contracts beyond the three-month Presence Care minimum
- Hourly billing
- Industry-specific or suburb-specific landing pages designed only for SEO
- Pitch decks and wireframe sign-offs before a build
- Stock photography on case studies
- Vague reporting that hides what isn't working
